query:
DELETE FROM request_templates
            WHERE id IN (
                SELECT template.id
                FROM (SELECT id FROM files
                      WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND retention_expired_at IS NULL) file,
                LATERAL (
                    SELECT id
                    FROM request_templates
                    WHERE file_id = file.id
                    LIMIT $1
                    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
                ) template
                LIMIT $1
            )
